newsitem.title: ROMANIA: First-tier Bucharest stocks dominate trading.
newsitem.headline: First-tier Bucharest stocks dominate trading.

text.p: First-tier stocks Azomures fertiliser maker and chemical plant Oltchim clung to centre-stage on Wednesday taking a combined 92 percent of the Bucharest bourse's turnover of 1.7 billion lei.
Azomures had some 508 million lei in turnover and closed 60 lei higher at 1,310, while Oltchim had a turnover of around 1.0 billion lei and ended the session slightly lower at 1,300.
Interest in the second tier was slim, with most of the 24 stocks trading mixed and three companies having no deal.
"This seems to have grown into a pattern by now, with everyone focusing on the two high-caps and paying little attention to the second tier," a trader said.
"The situation will change only when companies come out with relevant financial results," said another.
Listed companies are expected to make their 1996 results public by the end of the month or in the early weeks of April.
Policolor SA dye maker aroused some investor interest, having 43 million lei in turnover and inching 20 lei higher to a 1,300 close.
Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- rose from the previous session by 2.3 percent each.
The BIG for the first tier was 1,443.1 points on Wednesday, 3.38 percent up on the previous session. Its base is 1,000.
